name: Shigure Yadori
source:
An honor student heroine who is perfect, smart and intelligent. She is popular in class and loved by everyone.....at least, that's the front she puts on.

Deep down inside, she is filled with immeasurable possessiveness, a desire for approval, hideous hatred, and sheer jealousy. She shows this filthy inner self only to Amatarou, and binds him with any weakness she finds in him. 

She orders him to meet her behind the school on rainy days, and sometimes forces him to commit criminal and sexual acts.

[translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/11/10/rain/]official website[/url]]
